zones: the activated ability's represented active zone
events: commit its costs and permanent per-ability use
resolve a represented mana or stack ability
state_writes: one canonical Exhaust usage entry committed transactionally with the activation
costs: the represented activated ability's independently capability-closed cost
timing: the represented activated ability's ordinary timing plus any independently compiled restriction
targets: the represented activated ability's independently capability-closed target schema
choices: the represented activated ability's independently capability-closed choices
hidden_information: usage is authoritative state and only ordinary projected action availability is exposed
apnap: ordinary multiplayer priority and stack ordering apply
replacement_effects: represented result events retain their independent replacement boundaries after the Exhaust use commits
copy: copied or granted Exhaust abilities require a trusted typed ability-fragment owner
control_change: a consumed Exhaust ability remains consumed when another player controls the same object
zone_change: the physical card becomes a new object and its prior Exhaust usage no longer applies
source_leaves: an ordinary nonmana Exhaust ability already on the stack resolves independently of its source, except for results that explicitly require the current source zone object

variants: fixed source counter followed by one represented until-end characteristic result

implementation.component: ActivationLimit, activation_usage, typed activation query and commit, fixed and color-set mana descriptors, source-threaded effect sequence lowering, and semantic replacement continuation
implementation.supported_slice: Printed Exhaust abilities with independently closed costs and results; each printed instance may be used once by the same object. The initial harvest covers fixed-output mana and one fixed source-counter plus represented until-end characteristic sequence.

known_blockers: effects that permit an Exhaust ability to be activated again remain unsupported
triggers that observe Exhaust activations remain residual
copied, granted, removed, or layer-modified Exhaust abilities require trusted typed ability propagation
every other Exhaust result remains gated by its own effect, target, cost, and interaction capabilities
